about: The finishes the trusted render gives the Dwelling, chosen by the host. tile_m is the width in metres one tile covers on the building; boards_across turns the texture a quarter turn so its boards run horizontally, as weatherboards do; roughness is the finish's, uniform. Made by scripts/prepare_textures.py from Poly Haven's 2K maps (CC0 1.0).

white_planks_clean.tile_note: the source covers 1.8 m in 50 mm boards; shown at 150 mm boards, a weatherboard's width

box_profile_metal_sheet.use: 5-rib trapezoidal metal roofing, ribs down the slope

corrugated_iron.use: corrugated metal roofing, corrugations down the slope
